key_takeaways_en: Had a few other things going on to write about like Hearts of Iron 4 and Bosnia but here I am at the office late at night the night before yesterday your time and reports start coming in that the road surface on the Kerch Bridge is hanging grimly.

That’s when it started to become clear that the decision was made and Zelensky had pressed the red button all the way down with a wide grin.

key_takeaways_en: A secret scandal has quietly been brewing between Russian nuclear corporation Rosatom and Egypt over the construction of the El Dabaa Nuclear Power Plant on Egypt’s northwestern Mediterranean coast.

Materials provided to Frontelligence Insight by our source have revealed serious accusations made by the Egyptian Nuclear Power Plants Authority (NPPA) against Rosatom and its subsidiary Atomstroyexport.

analyses.summary_sv: Vi har nu nått den punkt i ukrainakriget där USA och Europa tidigare tvingades gå in och hjälpa Putin, och det är nog i det sken man skall se Trumps totalt tondöva fredsförsök just nu – det börjar återigen för den kanske femte gången i detta krig bli snårigt för Putin och han behöver akut hjälp att slingra sig ur det med hedern i behåll.
analyses.summary_en: Back to the fronts briefly but first the US “peace negotiations” – Kushner and Witkoff have thus marketed the ultimate cheat-win for Putin if anyone thought the record was hard to beat after all the cheating for almost five years, and it should have been.
key_takeaways_sv: Idag blir det ingen Trump-smashing men det verkar som han kommer gasa upp snarare än sakta ned framöver, tycker det finns lite tecken på det bland chipssmulorna.
Att USAs försvarsminister skriver ”patriots in control” och rysslands chefsförhandlare skriver (svarar) ”WWG1WGA” gör ju nästan foliehattarna till skarpa analytiker – den gillade vi inte.
Hösten 2022 var en till akut hjälpaktion och under 2023 hände det upprepade gånger när Ukraina gick över gränsen in till Kursk eller började dröna mot mål på djupet i Ryssland.
key_takeaways_en: Back to the fronts briefly but first the US “peace negotiations” – Kushner and Witkoff have thus marketed the ultimate cheat-win for Putin if anyone thought the record was hard to beat after all the cheating for almost five years, and it should have been.

Putin has not succeeded in conquering Donetsk and Luhansk Oblasts so they have asked Ukraine to redraw their internal community borders so Putin can officially claim that he has conquered both oblasts in their entirety and then be satisfied.

This is happening at the same time as Putin has pushed for incorrect staff maps for a year where he probably knows he does not control these areas but he controls the narrative to the US who either believe him or do not care.

analyses.summary_sv: När Ukraina har intensifierat sina attacker mot rysk infrastruktur, inklusive den ryska detaljhandelsjätten Wildberries i juli, har debatten om kampanjens effektivitet spridit sig över både sociala och traditionella medier, ofta med nästan lika frekvens som själva attackerna. Kommentatorer har erbjudit olika bedömningar av deras betydelse, vissa till och med hävdar att det helt enkelt är performativt.
analyses.summary_en: As Ukraine has intensified its strikes on Russian infrastructure, including the Russian retail giant Wildberries in July, debate over the effectiveness of the campaign has spread across both social and traditional media, often with nearly as much frequency as the strikes themselves. Commentators have offered differing assessments of their significance, some even arguing that it’s simply performative.
key_takeaways_sv: När Ukraina har intensifierat sina attacker mot rysk infrastruktur, inklusive den ryska detaljhandelsjätten Wildberries i juli, har debatten om kampanjens effektivitet spridit sig över både sociala och traditionella medier, ofta med nästan lika frekvens som själva attackerna.
Kommentatorer har erbjudit olika bedömningar av deras betydelse, vissa till och med hävdar att det helt enkelt är performativt.

Mycket av den offentliga diskussionen har fokuserat på de omedelbara konsekvenserna för detaljhandeln, inklusive förlust av lagerkapacitet, förstörda varor och den ekonomiska skada som Wildberries själva lidit.
key_takeaways_en: As Ukraine has intensified its strikes on Russian infrastructure, including the Russian retail giant Wildberries in July, debate over the effectiveness of the campaign has spread across both social and traditional media, often with nearly as much frequency as the strikes themselves.
Commentators have offered differing assessments of their significance, some even arguing that it’s simply performative.
Much of the public discussion has focused on the immediate retail consequences, including the loss of warehouse capacity, destroyed goods, and the financial damage suffered by Wildberries itself.
